title: Keep repository identities portable and quote shell operands
when: Reading source-discovery results, renderer outputs, doctor findings or a printed Bash recovery command.
need: Repository-relative identities use forward slashes on every operating system. Local absolute filesystem paths retain native spelling. Printed Bash commands quote path operands with shlex, including native Windows paths; copy the quoted command as printed.
surface: Event discovery, architect anticipation, agent renderer results, doctor scanners and printed recovery commands.
review: Source regressions cover the existing identity and command contracts. Native Windows suite acceptance remains pending.
